title: SMUI - Super Anvil
description: Adds Super Imbalance Anvil to your minecraft world!!
body:
This mod adds a special anvil that allows you to combine any enchantments mathematically, stacking their levels (for example: 1 + 1 = 2, 2 + 1 = 3, etc.) up to level 100.

Unlike the vanilla anvil, this anvil:

Does not break
Does not require absurdly high experience levels
Allows creating very high-level enchantments in a balanced but powerful way
The Super Anvil is designed as an endgame block.
Its crafting recipe is intentionally expensive and requires high-level enchanted books and rare materials.
This ensures that players must progress through the game before gaining access to its full power, keeping balance while still allowing extreme enchantment builds later on.

Upgrades:

1. 🛡 Kalter — Stability Artifact
- Prevents upgrade failures
- Each Kalter reduces the failure chance
- Max: 5
- At max level: 0% chance of failure
2. 🎲 Rintor — Luck Artifact
- Greatly increases the chance to gain extra enchantment levels
- Useful for pushing enchantments to very high levels
- Max: 10
- Up to 90% success chance
3. ⚡ Migur — Power Artifact
- Adds +1 bonus enchantment level during upgrades
- Works as an extra level boost on successful upgrades
- Max: 3
- Base chance without artifacts: 5%
